summary: Iteration 2 full E2E backend + frontend testing of Revenge Arc post-redesign. 27/27 pytest cases pass (19 baseline + 8 new for /api/admin/recipient-counts, /api/admin/announce with recipient_group, _wrap_email shell). Frontend verified: hero stats now honest (AI/Cinematic/Built — no 124K, 9.6, App Score), Arena headline is 'Built for warriors. One movement.', Emergent badge hidden on / and /admin/dashboard, all forms (waitlist, creator, admin password, broadcast subject, broadcast body) render dark text rgb(10,10,20) on light bg rgba(245,245,250,0.96), TikTok footer icon now 20x20 inside 44x44 button matching Instagram & Discord, admin Broadcast tab fully functional with 4 recipient cards (counts 7/13/3/19), 9 toolbar buttons, live email preview with INSTAGRAM/TIKTOK/DISCORD pills, confirmation modal opens on Send, Cancel and X both close it.

minor.issue: When Resend API key is in test mode and recipient is unverified, individual sends count toward 'failed'. Not a bug — UI surfaces the failed count, this is expected.

critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx had `h-4.5 w-4.5` Tailwind class on TikTokIcon which is NOT a valid Tailwind size (no .h-4.5 or .w-4.5 utility), causing the SVG to ignore the size constraint and render at intrinsic 42x42 inside the 44x44 button while IG/DC SVGs were 20x20. Fixed in this iteration to `h-5 w-5`. Recommend lint rule for Tailwind class validation (e.g., eslint-plugin-tailwindcss with arbitrary-value=false).

Broadcast.jsx insertAtCursor is robust but uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML in EmailPreview without sanitization — acceptable since only admin-authored content is rendered, but document this trust boundary.
_collect_recipients dedupe is correct (set of lowercased emails). Verified via test_announce_everyone_dedupes with seeded shared email — total recipients == /api/admin/recipient-counts.everyone.
Backend iterates emails sequentially via await; for groups >1k recipients consider asyncio.gather with semaphore (carry-over from iter1).
All env vars sourced correctly; no hardcoded URLs. ✅

data-testid attributes present on all new Broadcast UI: recipient-{group}, toolbar-{action}, broadcast-subject, broadcast-body, broadcast-send-btn, broadcast-confirm-modal, broadcast-confirm-btn, email-preview. ✅

rca of the issue: TikTok icon oversized: Tailwind doesn't ship `h-4.5`/`w-4.5` utilities by default. Class string was silently dropped, SVG rendered at viewBox-derived 42x42, while sibling Instagram (lucide-react) and Discord (custom SVG) used valid `h-5 w-5` (20px). Fix: replace with `h-5 w-5`. Verified after fix: all three SVGs measure 20x20 inside identical 44x44 buttons.
